create_qre_solver: create a QRE solver with configurable temperature, learning rates, and mirror descent or Euclidean projection
compute_qre_gradients: compute exploitability gradients and regularized exploitability estimates for a game with payoff matrices
run_mirror_descent_step: run entropic mirror descent step to update strategy distributions and auxiliary variables
run_euclidean_descent_step: run projected gradient descent step with Euclidean simplex projection on strategy distributions
compute_qre_exploitability: compute Tsallis entropy regularized exploitability for current strategy parameters
